key_implementation_notes.decoration_constant: SPIR-V Decoration::BuiltIn = 11 (NOT 33 — discovered during AT-1745 debugging; confirmed from spirv crate autogen_spirv.rs). The word-stream search in AT-1745 uses `BUILTIN_DECORATION: u32 = 11` and `LOCAL_INVOCATION_ID_VALUE: u32 = 27`.
key_implementation_notes.rspirv_disassembly_limitation: rspirv 0.12's Loader::disassemble fails on CooperativeMatrixKHR instructions (DetachedInstruction error). AT-1745 uses raw word-stream search instead of disassembly. AT-1741 codegen tests CAN use disassembly because they use emit_module directly without the full driver pipeline.
key_implementation_notes.strip_strategy_bug: The @strategy block strip in substitute_strategy_holes uses text search for '@strategy'. ANY occurrence of '@strategy' in comments triggers premature stripping. The matmul_msg_coopmat.axc header comment originally contained '@strategy' in a comment line; this caused compile failure. Fixed by removing '@strategy' from the comment text.
